# Line comment

-- a comment
local x = 1 -- trailing

==>

Chunk(Comment,Block(LocalStatement(local,AttribName(VariableDefinition),"=",Number)),
  Comment)

# Long comment

--[[ a long
     comment ]]
local x = 1

==>

Chunk(Comment,Block(LocalStatement(local,AttribName(VariableDefinition),"=",Number)))

# Long comment with a level

--[==[ contains ]] and ]=] without ending ]==]
local x = 1

==>

Chunk(Comment,Block(LocalStatement(local,AttribName(VariableDefinition),"=",Number)))

# Long string

s = [[line one
line two]]

==>

Chunk(Block(AssignStatement(Name,"=",LongString)))

# Long string with a level, containing a bracket

s = [==[ has ]] inside ]==]

==>

Chunk(Block(AssignStatement(Name,"=",LongString)))

# A long string is not indexing

t = a[[key]]

==>

Chunk(Block(AssignStatement(Name,"=",CallExpression(Name,LongString))))

# Ordinary indexing is not a long string

t = a[b]

==>

Chunk(Block(AssignStatement(Name,"=",IndexExpression(Name,"[",Name,"]"))))

# Escapes in a short string

s = "a\"b\n\65\x41\u{1F600}\z
     continued"

==>

Chunk(Block(AssignStatement(Name,"=",String)))

# Single quotes

s = 'it\'s'

==>

Chunk(Block(AssignStatement(Name,"=",String)))

# Shebang

#!/usr/bin/env lua
print("hi")

==>

Chunk(Comment,Block(ExpressionStatement(CallExpression(Name,ArgList("(",String,")")))))

# A hash after the first line is the length operator

n = #t

==>

Chunk(Block(AssignStatement(Name,"=",UnaryExpression(LengthOp,Name))))

# An unterminated long string runs to the end rather than eating the parse

s = [[ unterminated

==>

Chunk(Block(AssignStatement(Name,"=",LongString)))
